name: api-first
description: Extends the default review profile with API, contract, compatibility, and error-model checks.

common_issues.title: API contract changes are not reflected in clients, tests, or compatibility notes.
Error behavior is unspecified or inconsistent with existing API patterns.

design.title: API contract compatibility
design.description: Reviewer must identify request/response schema changes, status codes, pagination, versioning, backward compatibility, and client impact.

design.title: Error model contract
design.description: Reviewer must check that validation, authorization, conflict, idempotency, and downstream failure responses match the project API style.

test.title: Producer/consumer contract tests
test.description: Reviewer must verify tests cover changed API schemas, status codes, error bodies, compatibility guarantees, and representative client expectations.

test.title: Backward compatibility tests
test.description: Reviewer should check compatibility tests or explicit risk acceptance for removed fields, stricter validation, changed defaults, or status-code changes.

implementation.title: API schema stability
implementation.description: Reviewer must compare implementation, DTOs, serializers, OpenAPI/docs, and clients against the declared API contract.

implementation.title: Idempotency and retry semantics
implementation.description: Reviewer must verify repeated calls, retries, duplicate messages, and downstream timeouts preserve the documented API behavior.
